Definition: something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove
BiblicalUsage: The word is a gathering, and it gathers two meanings: the gathering together of the waters which God called Seas, and the hope of Israel, the LORD Himself. Jeremiah calls Him the hope of Israel and the Saviour in time of trouble.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two meanings are one: hope is a gathering, the waters gathered into seas and the people gathered to God, and the LORD is the hope because He is the One who gathers.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
